faqs.question: How do I obtain the latest product software for Windows or my Mac?
faqs.answer: You can download the latest product driver from the Downloads section of this website.

faqs.question: A label peeled off in the product. How should I remove it?
faqs.answer:
Press the product's
LF/FF
button until the label appears on the platen and remove the label. If you can't remove the label this way, do not remove the platen from the product. Get the printer serviced.
Note:
We recommend you use the pull tractor to print labels. Labels fed through the rear push tractor can curl and peel off under the platen.

faqs.question: Where do I find my product's serial number?
faqs.answer:
See our
Finding Your Epson Product Serial Number
page for details.

faqs.question: Can I use the platen knob to load or adjust paper?
faqs.answer:
No. Use the Load/Eject button to load or remove paper and the micro adjust feature to
Adjusting the top-of-form position
. The knob should only be used to clear paper jams after the printer has been turned off.

faqs.question: Can my product emulate an IBM Proprinter?
faqs.answer:
Yes, this printer emulates the IBM Proprinter.  For more information see
IBM PPDS emulation control codes
.

faqs.question: Why does my product stop or pause in the middle of a large print job?
faqs.answer: The printer will pause or stop if it's waiting for more data or processing data received from a computer. It may also pause or slow down to ensure the print head does not overheat. It resumes printing once the print head has cooled down.

faqs.question: What is the recommended duty cycle for my product?
faqs.answer: The recommended duty cycle is 25 percent. This describes the printer's condition when it is printing (not idle) for 8 hours a day.

faqs.question: Are dip switches used to change settings on my product?
faqs.answer:
No. The printer has built-in default settings. You can change the settings using the printer's front panel buttons. For more information, see
Changing Default Settings
.

faqs.question: My product is beeping. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
The printer beeps when an error occurs or a panel operation is made.  See
Using the Error Indicators
for more information.

faqs.question: My product will not print through a PC serial connection. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Check the following:
Make sure you're using a null modem cable.
Make sure the serial connection settings on the printer matches the settings on your computer. See
Changing default settings
to change the printer's settings.
Make sure the cable connection is not loose.
Try a different cable.
